arm: arc3-r20-w7-a v4: rank 20's harnesses/minimal-w7 bundle on their own runtime, 7 lanes, 1,900 s per game
what_it_took_to_run: v1: their setup hid the server error behind a 120-line tail
v2: PLE offload IPC died on pidfd_getfd EPERM under expandable_segments:True; set False
v3: FlashInfer JIT found no SM12x arch for cutlass_fused_moe_sm120; set FLASHINFER_CUDA_ARCH_LIST=12.0a
note: Their reported 54 to 60 levels were GCP runs with native FP8 PLE; on the Kaggle card with preconverted BF16 PLE and our fixes it benches 45. The outputs were not saved (their notebook keeps only the zip); levels are read from the kernel log's final PUBLIC25 summary.
verdict: TIE with GG7, below the Scott fork. Does not ship tonight. Worth keeping: it is a second working serving stack with fp8 KV and 7 lanes of 103k context on this card.
